bindings.name: aggregation_commitment
bindings.note: aggregate_commitments keyed on the presentation pseudonym instead of the v1 holder commitment; the verifier MUST recompute it from the envelope's component proofs and the registry-pinned circuit identities.

bindings.name: aggregated_claim_binding
bindings.note: poseidon2(aggregation_commitment, context); the verifier MUST recompute it and reject on mismatch.

bindings.name: presentation_pseudonym
bindings.source: envelope:presentationBinding.pseudonym — MUST equal the scoped envelope binding pseudonym and be non-zero: same-holder aggregation is a continuity claim, so anonymous proofs are not aggregable. Each component proof's own first public input MUST also equal it.

bindings.name: scope_id
bindings.source: envelope:presentationBinding.scopeId — MUST equal the envelope binding scope and be non-zero: aggregation requires the scoped presentation profile.

bindings.name: context
bindings.source: context:value — MUST equal the authenticated request context hash for this presentation.

bindings.name: num_proofs
bindings.source: envelope:proofs — MUST equal the number of component proofs the envelope aggregates (1..8); slots at or beyond it MUST carry zero commitments.

bindings.name: input_proof_commitments
bindings.note: Each active slot MUST equal the commitment recomputed over that component proof's verification-key stand-in (derived from the registry-pinned circuit for the slot's proof type, not from the envelope), proof, public inputs, and proof type, under the deployment-defined packing (reference: python/zkc_holder/aggregation.py); inactive slots MUST be 0.
